DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 税の通知についてのご相談ですね。お手元の書類で、どの部分が気になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.translation: This is about a tax notice. Which part of your documents concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この納付書が届きました。でも給与からも税金が引かれているので、同じ分を二度払うのか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 納付書が届いた一方で給与控除もあると説明し、二重払いを心配していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.translation: This payment slip arrived. But tax is also deducted from my salary, so I'm worried I'm being asked to pay the same thing twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Explain receiving a payment slip alongside salary deductions and concern about duplicate payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 税金という言葉だけでは同じものか判断できません。通知の発行元と、給与明細の控除欄を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.translation: The word tax alone doesn't tell us whether it is the same tax. May I see the notice issuer and the deductions section of your payslip?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 発行元はこの欄ですね。明細のほうは字が小さくて読めません。控除の項目名を一緒に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 通知の発行元の欄を確認し、明細の小さい控除項目名を一緒に読んでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.translation: This is the issuer field, right? The payslip print is too small for me to read. Please check the deduction item name with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Identify the notice issuer field and request help reading the small deduction name on the payslip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 通知には住民税、こちらの控除欄には所得税と書かれています。名目は異なりますが、納付の状況は通知の担当先への確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.translation: The notice says resident tax and this deduction says income tax. The names differ, but payment status needs checking with the notice's responsible office.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 書かれている税の種類は違うのですね。勤務先で住民税も引いているか、何を聞けば確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 税の名目の違いを確認し、勤務先に住民税の控除をどう尋ねるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.translation: So the stated tax types differ. What should I ask my workplace to find out whether they also deduct resident tax?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm the different tax names and ask how to inquire about resident-tax deductions at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 給与担当には、住民税の控除があるかと、あれば対象の年度を尋ねるとよいでしょう。通知の担当先には納付書の番号も伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.translation: Ask payroll whether resident tax is deducted and, if so, which fiscal year it covers. Give the payment-slip number to the notice office too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 勤務先には控除の有無と年度、通知の担当先には納付書番号を伝えます。全額をすぐ用意できない場合も、同じ担当先で相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 勤務先には控除の有無と年度、通知先には納付書番号を伝えると整理し、全額をすぐ用意できない場合の相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.translation: I'll ask my workplace about the deduction and year, and give the notice office the slip number. If I can't immediately afford the full amount, can I consult the same office?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Organize the workplace deduction and year questions and notice number, and ask where to consult about inability to pay in full immediately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 通知に納付相談の連絡先があるか確認しましょう。支払い方法の変更が認められるかは、事情を説明して担当者に確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.translation: Let's check whether the notice lists a payment consultation contact. Whether a change of payment method is allowed requires explaining your circumstances to the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: では、この相談先に連絡します。納期限も読み取れたので、その前に電話して、必要な持ち物を聞いてから相談に行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 通知の相談先へ納期限前に電話し、必要な持ち物を聞いてから訪問すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.translation: Then I'll contact this consultation office. I've read the deadline too, so I'll call before then and ask what to bring before visiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Call the notice's consultation office before the deadline and ask required items before visiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 通知と給与明細をなくさないようにお持ちください。確認した項目をメモしてお渡しします。本日のご相談は以上です。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-OKINAWACITY-08-001-SHARED.translation: Keep the notice and payslip safe. I'll give you notes of the items we checked. That concludes today's consultation. Take care.

DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その二つのバッグで迷っていらっしゃいますか。お使いになる場面を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you deciding between those two bags? What will you use it for?

DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車通勤で使います。弁当の汁がこぼれることもあるので、洗える方を探しています。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車通勤と汁漏れの可能性を伝え、水洗いできるバッグを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-02.translation: For cycling to work. My lunch can leak, so I'm looking for one I can wash with water.
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain bicycle commuting and possible food leaks and request a washable bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紺色は手洗いできますが、茶色は水洗い不可です。紺色の中に、お弁当箱が収まるか確かめましょうか。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-03.translation: Navy can be hand-washed, but brown cannot be washed with water. Shall we check whether your lunch box fits the navy one?

DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 空の弁当箱を持ってきました。底を平らにしたまま入るか試してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参した空の弁当箱を平らに入れる試用許可を得る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've brought an empty lunch box. May I try putting it in with the bottom kept level?
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask permission to test your own empty lunch box with its base level. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。横にするとふたが傾きますが、この向きなら収まりますね。ただ、保冷機能はありません。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do. Sideways makes the lid tilt, but this direction fits. It has no insulating function, though.

DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の保冷袋に入れて使います。その袋も入るように、幅をあと二センチほど確保できますか。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保冷袋を使う予定を伝え、幅を二センチ広げられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use a separate insulated pouch. Can we allow about two more centimeters of width to fit that too?
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your insulated-pouch plan and ask for two centimeters more width. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 側面のボタンを外すと広がります。バッグは三千二百円、取り外せる肩ひもは別売りで八百円です。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-07.translation: Undoing the side buttons expands it. The bag is thirty-two hundred yen; the removable shoulder strap is sold separately for eight hundred.

DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 上限は三千五百円なので、肩ひもは付けません。持ち手だけでも肩に掛けられますか。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三千五百円の予算から肩ひもを外し、持ち手を肩に掛けられるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-08.translation: My limit is thirty-five hundred, so I won't add the strap. Can I put just the handles over my shoulder?
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Omit the strap to stay within thirty-five hundred yen and ask whether the handles fit over your shoulder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 薄手の上着なら掛けられます。鏡の前でお試しください。持ち手の付け根が当たらないでしょうか。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-09.translation: With a thin jacket, yes. Try in front of the mirror. Do the handle bases press against you?

DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 当たりませんし、箱も傾きません。この紺色をバッグだけで買います。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持ち手と箱の安定を確かめ、紺色のバッグ本体だけを購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-10.translation: They don't, and the box doesn't tilt either. I'll buy just this navy bag without extras.
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the handle comfort and box stability and buy only the navy bag itself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、肩ひもなしで三千二百円のお会計です。手洗いの表示も残してお使いください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-OKN-URASOE-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then that's thirty-two hundred yen without the shoulder strap. Keep the hand-washing label when using it. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出荷指示の紙を受け取りましたね。持ち出す前に、棚の箱と番号を照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've received the dispatch instruction sheet. Compare its number with the box on the shelf before taking anything out.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 指示は末尾が四一ですが、棚の箱は一四です。中身が同じでも、この箱は動かさない方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 末尾四一と一四の食い違いを報告し、箱を動かす前に判断を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The instructions end in four-one, but the shelf box ends in one-four. Even if the contents are the same, should I leave this box unmoved?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the four-one versus one-four mismatch and request a decision before moving the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 動かさず保留にしましょう。棚位置と箱の番号を私が確認します。箱はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's hold it without moving it. I'll check the shelf location and box number. Where is the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: Ｂ列の三段目にあります。箱が奥に寄っていて、床からではラベルの上半分が読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: Ｂ列三段目という位置と、床からラベルを読み切れない状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the third level of row B. The box is far back, so I can't read the upper half of the label from the floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give row B, third level and explain that the full label cannot be read from the floor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 棚には登らないでください。読み取りは担当者に依頼します。あなたは指示の紙を持って、照合台まで来てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't climb the shelving. We'll ask the designated staff to read it. Bring the instruction sheet to the checking table.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 照合台への近道は車両通路を横切ります。歩行者用の通路から回ると、どの入口に出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車両通路を避けた歩行経路が照合台のどの入口へ出るか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The shortcut to that table crosses the vehicle lane. If I go around on the pedestrian path, which entrance do I reach?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which checking-table entrance the pedestrian route reaches while avoiding vehicle lanes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この図の青い線に沿うと、照合台の裏の入口に着きます。途中の横断部は今、運搬中なので待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Following this map's blue line reaches the rear entrance. Wait at the crossing on the way because goods are being transported there now.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 横断部の手前で待ちます。荷物が出ていない理由は、出荷係にも伝えておきましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 横断前で待つと伝え、出荷係への保留理由の連絡を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait before the crossing. Shall I also tell dispatch staff why the goods haven't gone out?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait before crossing and offer to tell dispatch staff the hold reason. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。「番号の相違を確認中で、Ｂ列の箱は未移動」と伝えてください。出荷を再開する判断は私がします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Say that a number discrepancy is being checked and the row B box hasn't been moved. I will decide when dispatch resumes.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出荷係にはその二点を伝え、私からは再開の約束をしません。連絡後に歩行者通路で照合台へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号相違確認中・箱未移動だけを連絡し、再開を約束せず照合台へ行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell them those two points and won't promise a restart myself. After that, I'll use the pedestrian route to the checking table.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report only the number discrepancy check and unmoved box, avoid a restart promise and proceed to the checking table. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。私は箱を確認してから照合台で合流します。それでは、足元に気をつけて移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. I'll inspect the box and meet you at the table. Watch your step as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経路をお調べしましょうか。目的地の案内に最寄り駅は書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I look up a route? Does your destination information name the nearest station?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 展示会の案内には「花野駅から徒歩十分」とあります。乗り換えが少ない行き方を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示会の最寄りを花野駅と伝え、乗り換えの少ない経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The exhibition guide says ten minutes on foot from Hanano Station. I'd like a route with few transfers.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give Hanano as the nearest station and request few transfers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この経路表では、一回乗り換える便と、直通便が出ています。直通便は待ち時間が長く、会場到着が二十分遅くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This route table shows a one-transfer service and a direct one. The direct service has a longer wait and reaches the venue twenty minutes later.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入場は四時までなので、二十分遅くても間に合います。直通便で、駅に着く時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 四時の入場期限に余裕があると判断し、直通便の到着時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Entry is until four, so twenty minutes later still works. Please tell me when the direct service arrives at the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Judge that the four-o'clock entry deadline allows the later arrival and ask the direct service's arrival time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この表示では三時二十分着です。徒歩十分を足すと三時半ですが、会場までの道は主催者の地図でも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: This display says three twenty. Adding the ten-minute walk makes three thirty, but also check the organizer's map for the route to the venue.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅からの地図は持っています。券売機に表示されているこの切符は、帰りも使える往復券でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 徒歩地図を所持していると伝え、券売機に表示された切符が往復券か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the walking map. Is this ticket on the machine a round-trip ticket that I can use on the way back too?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the walking map and check whether the displayed ticket covers a round trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その表示は片道券です。帰りは別に購入してください。今日は往復以外にも移動されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is a one-way ticket. Buy your return separately. Are you making any other journeys today?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかには移動しません。帰りの時刻がまだ決まらないので、今は行きの片道券だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 往復以外の移動はなく、帰りが未定のため行きの片道だけを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No other journeys. My return time is undecided, so I'll get just the outward one-way ticket now.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain no other travel and choose only the outward one-way ticket because the return is undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら、こちらの券売機で花野までを選んでください。直通便の乗り場は二番ですが、次の発車は別の行き先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then select Hanano on this machine. The direct service leaves from platform two, but the next departure goes somewhere else.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次の便には乗らず、花野行きの表示が出るまで待ちます。片道券を買ってから二番へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次発の別行き先には乗らず、券購入後に二番で花野行きの表示を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't board the next departure; I'll wait for the Hanano destination display. I'll buy the one-way ticket and then go to platform two.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid the next service to another destination and wait at platform two for Hanano after buying the ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 花野行きという表示と時刻を、乗車前にもう一度お確かめください。展示会、楽しんでいらしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Check the Hanano destination and departure time again before boarding. Enjoy the exhibition.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約変更のお電話ですね。予約票のお名前と日時をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're calling to change an appointment. Please give the name and date and time on your appointment slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: グエン・ロンです。木曜十時の定期確認を変更したいです。同じ日に弟も予約していますが、弟の分は残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人の木曜十時だけを変更し、弟の予約を残すよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nguyen Long. I'd like to change my Thursday ten-o'clock routine check. My younger brother has an appointment the same day, but please leave his in place.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Change only your Thursday ten-o'clock appointment and retain your younger brother's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人の登録がありますので、ご本人分を特定します。診察券の末尾四桁を読んでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have registrations for both of you, so let's identify yours. Could you read the last four digits of your patient card?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の末尾は三六二八です。弟の予約時刻はわからないので、その番号の予約だけ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の診察券末尾三六二八で特定し、弟の時刻を推測しないよう求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mine ends three-six-two-eight. I don't know my brother's appointment time, so please check only the appointment under that number.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify your own card ending three-six-two-eight and avoid guessing your brother's time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 三六二八のロン様は木曜十時ですね。次の木曜なら九時か十一時半に空きがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Long, ending three-six-two-eight, is Thursday at ten. The following Thursday has openings at nine or eleven thirty.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十一時半なら休暇を取れます。同じ先生の定期確認として予約できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次の木曜十一時半を選び、同じ先生の定期確認枠か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can take leave for eleven thirty. Can I book that as a routine check with the same doctor?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose eleven thirty the following Thursday and ask whether it is a routine slot with the same doctor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その枠は前回と同じ先生です。症状が変わっている場合は、予約変更だけでよいか診療担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That slot is with your previous doctor. If symptoms have changed, we'll ask clinical staff whether changing the appointment alone is sufficient.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 痛みや腫れはなく、前回から変化もありません。今回は勤務日の変更が理由です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 痛み・腫れ・前回からの変化はなく、勤務変更が理由と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There's no pain or swelling and nothing has changed since last time. The reason this time is a change in my workdays.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain no pain, swelling or change since last time and that work scheduling is the reason. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、ご本人分を次の木曜十一時半に変更しました。弟様の予約には触れていません。変更票は次回来院時にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I've changed yours to the following Thursday at eleven thirty. Your brother's appointment is untouched. We'll give you the change slip at your next visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手元の予約票には、私の分だけ次の木曜十一時半と書き直します。弟にも、予約は変わっていないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の予約票だけを書き直し、弟の予約が変わっていないことを伝える予定を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll rewrite only my own slip as next Thursday at eleven thirty. I'll tell my brother his appointment hasn't changed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Rewrite only your own appointment slip and confirm that you will tell your brother his appointment is unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で承っています。お越しの際は診察券をお持ちください。それでは、お電話ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: That's what we have registered. Bring your patient card when you come. Thank you for calling.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は包装の補助です。入室確認表は、どこまで済んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today you're assisting with packing. How far have you completed the entry checklist?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 着替えと手洗いは済みましたが、粘着ローラーをまだ使っていません。確認表のこの順番で続ければいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ローラー未実施を申告し、掲示の入室確認順序で続けてよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've changed clothes and washed my hands, but haven't used the adhesive roller yet. Should I continue in this checklist order?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that roller cleaning is incomplete and check following the posted entry sequence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。この掲示どおりに行い、最後に相互確認をしましょう。その後、作業台の日付見本を指示書と照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. Follow the posted sequence and finish with a mutual check. Then compare the worktop date sample with the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入室確認は終わりました。指示書は十五日なのに、作業台の見本は十四日になっています。前日の見本でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入室確認完了と、十五日の指示書に対して十四日の見本という不一致を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Entry checks are complete. The instructions say the fifteenth, but the sample on the worktop says the fourteenth. Is it yesterday's sample?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report completed entry checks and the fifteenth-versus-fourteenth date mismatch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その可能性がありますが、確認するまで印字は始めません。見本は私が持って責任者に確認します。機械には触れず待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: It may be, but don't start printing until we check. I'll take the sample to the supervisor. Wait without touching the machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開始を待ちます。既に台の横にある二箱は、確認前の品として分けておいた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 印字を始めず待つと伝え、既存の二箱をどう扱うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wait to start. Should the two boxes already beside the table be separated as unchecked items?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Wait without printing and ask how to handle the two existing boxes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二箱の扱いも責任者が判断します。今は箱を動かさず、他の人が流さないよう私から保留を伝えます。箱の表示を読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The supervisor decides about those boxes too. Don't move them now; I'll tell others to hold them so they aren't sent along. Can you read the box markings?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二箱とも「試し印字」と表示されています。出荷用の箱には混ぜず、この位置にあると責任者へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二箱の試し印字表示を読み上げ、出荷用に混ぜず位置を責任者へ伝えるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both say test printing. Please don't mix them into dispatch boxes, and tell the supervisor they're in this location.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the test-printing labels and ask that the supervisor be told their location without mixing them with dispatch stock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 位置と表示を伝えました。新しい見本の承認までは待機です。清掃に切り替えず、この待機欄に時刻と理由を記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've reported the location and labels. Wait until the new sample is approved. Don't switch to cleaning; record the time and reason in this waiting field.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待機欄に、九時十分から日付見本の不一致を確認中と記録します。再開の指示が出るまで包装は始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 九時十分から日付見本不一致で待機と記録し、再開指示までは包装しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll record waiting from nine ten while the date-sample discrepancy is checked. I won't start packing until a restart instruction is given.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record waiting from nine ten for the date mismatch and do not pack before restart instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録を確認しました。私が責任者の返答を受けて再開を伝えます。では、いったん待機場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've checked the record. I'll tell you to restart after receiving the supervisor's response. Please wait in the waiting area for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日の領収書と診療明細書です。お名前の表記をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here are today's receipt and medical itemized statement. Please check the spelling of your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名前は合っています。会社から受診日がわかる物を出すよう言われましたが、この二枚のどちらを渡せばいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 氏名確認を済ませ、職場に求められた受診日の証明にどちらの書類を使うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My name is correct. My company asked for something showing the visit date; which of these two should I give them?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm your name and ask which document to use as the workplace's visit-date proof. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらにも受診日はありますが、提出先が求める書類は会社にご確認ください。領収書は支払額、明細書は診療項目を確認する書類です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Both show the date, but check with your company which document they require. The receipt confirms payment, and the statement confirms clinical items.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 明細には診療の内容まで載るのですね。必要以上に出したくないので、会社に領収書だけでよいか聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診療内容まで不要に提出せず、領収書のみでよいか職場へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the statement even includes treatment details. I don't want to submit more than necessary, so I'll ask whether the receipt alone is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid unnecessary treatment disclosure and ask your workplace whether the receipt alone suffices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会社の指定がわかるまで、二枚ともお手元に保管してください。ここで連絡を取っていただいても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Keep both until you know the company's requirements. You may contact them here.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今、会社から返事が来ました。今日来院した確認は領収書でよいそうですが、三日休むなら別に診断書が必要だそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場の返答として、来院確認は領収書、三日の休業には別の診断書が必要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My company has replied now. They say the receipt is enough to confirm today's visit, but a separate medical certificate is needed if I take three days off.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the workplace response that the receipt proves attendance but three days off needs a separate certificate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 休む期間などの記載は医師への相談が必要です。受付で三日間の休業をお約束することはできません。申込みの窓口をご案内しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The period off and other details need discussion with a doctor. Reception can't promise three days of leave. Shall I show you the application counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。ただ、診断書の内容が決まる前に三日休めると会社に断言しないようにします。申込み前に料金と受取方法も聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休業期間を先に断言しないと伝え、診断書申込み前の料金と受取方法の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. But I won't tell my company for certain that I can take three days off before the certificate's contents are decided. May I ask the cost and collection method before applying too?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid claiming a leave period in advance and request certificate costs and collection details before application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類担当が申込みの際に料金と受取方法をご説明します。お渡しできる時期もそこでご相談ください。担当への受付番号を発行します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Documents staff will explain the fees and collection method when you apply. Discuss when it can be provided there too. I'll issue a queue number for them.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 領収書は今日の受診確認として会社に出し、診断書は書類担当で説明を聞いてから申込みを判断します。受付番号をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書を受診確認として提出し、診断書は説明後に判断するため書類担当の受付番号を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll submit the receipt to confirm today's visit and decide on the certificate after hearing the documents staff's explanation. Please give me the queue number.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Submit the receipt for attendance and request a documents queue number to decide on the certificate after explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが書類担当の受付番号です。お手元の書類をなくさないよう、お待ちください。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your documents-counter number. Keep your papers safe while waiting. Please take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 応援シャツですね。ご自分用ですか、それとも贈り物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: A supporters' shirt. Is it for yourself or a gift?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 兄への誕生日プレゼントです。普段はＭですが、下に厚手の服を着るので、仕上がり寸法を比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 兄への贈り物と重ね着の予定を伝え、ＭとＬの仕上がり寸法を比べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: A birthday gift for my older brother. He usually wears M but will wear thick clothes underneath, so I'd like to compare finished measurements.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the gift and layering plan and compare M and L finished measurements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ＭとＬの身幅はこちらの表で比べられます。試着用も一枚ずつあります。お兄様のシャツを測った寸法はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can compare M and L body widths in this chart. We have one fitting sample of each. Do you know the measurements of one of his shirts?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: よく着ているシャツの身幅は五十四センチです。この表ならＬが近いので、Ｌの試着用を広げてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 兄のシャツの身幅五十四センチを根拠に、Ｌの試着品を広げてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: His usual shirt is fifty-four centimeters wide. L looks close on this chart; could you spread out the L sample?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the brother's fifty-four-centimeter shirt width to request the L fitting sample laid out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらです。背中に名前も入れられますが、名入れした商品はサイズ交換の対象外です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here it is. We can add a name to the back, but personalized items aren't eligible for size exchange.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: サイズが確実ではないので、今日は名入れをしません。未加工のままなら、兄が着られない場合に交換を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名入れを見送り、未加工商品ならサイズ交換を相談できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm not certain of the size, so no personalization today. If it's unaltered and doesn't fit my brother, can I ask about an exchange?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Skip personalization and ask whether an unaltered item can be considered for size exchange. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この売店では購入から七日以内で、未使用、タグ付き、レシートありなら相談できます。ご兄弟にはいつ渡す予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here we can discuss exchange within seven days, unused, with tags and receipt. When will you give it to your brother?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 渡すのは十日後なので、その期限には間に合いませんね。今日は買わず、寸法の表をメモして本人に聞いてから来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十日後の贈呈では七日の期限を過ぎると判断し、購入を保留して寸法を本人に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: In ten days, so that misses the deadline. I won't buy today; I'll note the size chart and ask him before returning.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Recognize a ten-day gift date exceeds the seven-day limit and hold off buying to ask the recipient about measurements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。Ｌは身幅五十五センチ、着丈七十二センチです。取り置きはしていないので、次回の在庫は改めてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. L is fifty-five centimeters wide and seventy-two long. We don't reserve stock, so check availability again next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 身幅と着丈を控えました。在庫の確保は頼まず、兄に寸法を確かめてから、もう一度売り場で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 身幅と着丈を控え、在庫確保を求めず本人確認後に再相談する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've noted the width and length. I won't request a reservation; I'll check measurements with my brother and consult at the shop again afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record width and length and explain that you will reconfirm with your brother and return without requesting stock reservation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お兄様に寸法を聞いてからですと選びやすくなりますね。またのお越しをお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Asking him the measurements will make choosing easier. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の確認ですね。確定する前に、気になる点を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're checking a bank transfer. Tell me any concerns before confirming it.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 講習の受講料を入力したら、受取人に会社名ではなく個人名が出ました。請求書は会社名なので、まだ確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社宛て請求なのに個人名が表示され、振込を未確定にしていると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I entered the course fee, the recipient showed a person's name instead of a company. The invoice is in the company name, so I haven't confirmed it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain a personal recipient name despite a company invoice and that the transfer is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確定せずお待ちください。入力した銀行名、支店、口座番号が請求書と一致するか、ここで照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please wait without confirming. Let's compare the bank, branch and account number you entered with the invoice here.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 銀行と支店は合っていますが、口座番号の最後を八ではなく六と入力していました。元の請求書を見ながら直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 口座番号の末尾八を六と入力した誤りを発見し、原本を見て修正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bank and branch match, but I entered six instead of eight as the final account digit. I'll correct it while looking at the original invoice.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Find the final account digit error of six instead of eight and correct it using the original. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 修正後も、受取人名が請求書の記載と一致するかお確かめください。名義だけで請求そのものの正当性を保証できるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: After correcting, check that the recipient matches the invoice too. The account name alone doesn't guarantee the invoice itself is legitimate.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 直しても個人名のままです。請求書にある連絡先へ確認する前に、講習申込み時の控えにある窓口にも連絡した方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 修正後も個人名と報告し、申込み時の既知窓口への確認方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even after correction it's still a person's name. Before checking the contact on the invoice, should I also contact the office on my original course-application record?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the personal name remains and ask about checking the previously known application contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 既にご存じの連絡先で確認する方法があります。確認先と名義の説明に納得できるまでは、送金を進めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: One option is to check through contact details you already know. Don't proceed until you're satisfied about whom you're checking with and the account-name explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 申込み時の控えで連絡先を確認します。支払期限は明日ですが、今日はこの振込を保留して持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既知の連絡先で確認すると決め、期限が明日でも今日の振込を保留できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check the contact from my application record. The deadline is tomorrow, but may I hold this transfer today and go home?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the known contact and ask to hold today's transfer even though payment is due tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ確定していないので、この入力は取り消せます。振込は実行されません。請求書の原本もお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Since it's unconfirmed, we can cancel this entry. No transfer will execute. We'll return the original invoice too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入力を取り消してください。受講先から名義の説明を受けるまでは送金せず、原本を持って確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入力の取消しと原本の返却を求め、受講先の名義説明を受けるまで送金しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please cancel the entry. I won't send money until the course provider explains the account name; I'll take the original and check.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request entry cancellation and return of the original and explain that you will not transfer before the provider explains the account name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 入力を取り消しました。本日の振込実行はありません。請求書をお確かめのうえ、お持ち帰りください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKN-URASOE-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've canceled the entry. No transfer has been executed today. Please check your invoice and take it home. Take care.

DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 島へ行かれるんですね。片道の切符をお求めですか。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're going to an island. Would you like a one-way ticket?

DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日帰りのつもりなので、行きより先に帰りの最終便を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日帰りのため帰りの最終便を先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm planning a day trip, so I'd like to know the last return sailing before the outbound one.
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the last return sailing first because it is a day trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 帰りの予定も大事ですね。今日は島で何時まで過ごす予定ですか。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Return plans matter too. Until what time do you plan to stay on the island today?

DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四時ごろまでですが、帰りが早ければ昼食の後に港へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 島に滞在する希望時刻と変更可能な予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Until around four, but if the return is earlier, I'll go back to the port after lunch.
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your preferred island departure time and explain that plans are flexible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内では三時半が最後ですから、四時までいると間に合いません。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-05.translation: This guide says the last is three thirty, so staying until four would be too late.

DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら三時には港に着くようにします。帰りの切符もここで買えますか。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰港時刻を早めて帰りの券の購入場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll get to the port by three. Can I buy the return ticket here too?
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Move the port-return time earlier and ask where to buy the return ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 帰りの券の扱いを確認しますので、行き先の島を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check how return tickets work. Which island are you going to?

DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 白石島へ行きます。乗る場所が行きと帰りで違わないかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 行き先の島を伝えて往復の乗り場を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Shiraishi Island. Please also tell me whether boarding places differ outbound and return.
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Name the destination island and check boarding locations both ways. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 行きはこちらの乗り場です。帰りの乗り場は、この案内図でお示ししますね。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Outbound boarding is here. I'll show the return boarding point on this map.

DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 図の港へ三時までに戻ります。帰りの券について確認できたら、往路も購入します。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰港時刻を復唱して券の確認後に購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll return to the mapped port by three. Once you've checked the return ticket, I'll buy the outbound one too.
DLG-SC-OKY-KASAOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat the port return time and purchase after ticket arrangements are checked. Say it in Japanese.
